purpose: Additional evidence refresh for the 44-country calculator project. Research only; do not activate or merge this record as a calculator profile.

currency.name: Libyan dinar
currency.caveat: 2026 FAO brief reports about 15% year-on-year dinar weakening by May 2026. Preserve official and any parallel exchange-rate series separately; no input conversion is inferred here.

crop_mix_2024_secondary_faostat_compilat.warning: Secondary FAOSTAT compilation; verify exact item/element/year through primary FAOSTAT before operational use.

production.quality: SESRIC barley yield is displayed as 513 hg/ha (0.0513 t/ha), inconsistent with 65,000 tonnes divided by 126,698 hectares. Retain source value as flagged; do not silently correct. These are national series, not district yields.

outlook.notes: 2026 winter wheat/barley harvest expected May-July; dry October-November 2025 delayed planting; eastern rainfall remained below average, especially Al Jabal Al Akhdar. 2026/27 cereal import requirement forecast 3.3 million tonnes; not a farm production or profitability input.

production_geography.regional_crop_context: IFAD country strategy identifies tomatoes, peppers, onions and leafy greens as common crops; olives and pulses in Al Jabal Al Gharbi; citrus around Derna; dates in Al Jufra; barley and fodder in Fezzan. Treat as qualitative crop-location context, not measured county-level yields.

world_bank.method: Direct WFP/FAO/selected NSO observations plus machine-learning estimates and modeled price ranges; outliers may be adjusted.
world_bank.caveat: Market/consumer price estimates, not verified farmgate producer prices. Keep observed and modeled values distinct.

official_trade_network.publisher: Libya Trade Network, Ministry of Economy and Trade
official_trade_network.scope: Annual high, low, average and change statistics for food, meat, poultry, eggs, vegetables, fruits, grains and animal feed.
official_trade_network.caveat: XLSX exists but has not been extracted here; local market price level and geographic coverage must be checked.

local_price_index.caveat: Retail/local market bulletin; not a farmgate price schedule or complete input quotation. Product brands/grades and market coverage must be preserved.

costs_and_enterprise_budgets.fertilizer: No verified current farmer-paid fertilizer prices and application rates extracted.

costs_and_enterprise_budgets.irrigation_energy: Water scarcity, energy reliability and regional irrigation constraints require farm-level costs; no verified per-hectare water/pumping cost series extracted.
costs_and_enterprise_budgets.labour: No current region-by-operation agricultural wage table validated in this batch.
costs_and_enterprise_budgets.machinery: No current machinery hire/land-preparation price schedule extracted.

costs_and_enterprise_budgets.historic_study: A 2019/20 Al-Bayda vegetable marketing-cost study covers tomato, cucumber, eggplant and dry onion; historical municipal case study only, not current production budgets. https://journal.su.edu.ly/index.php/bayan/en/article/view/2205
